ValidationRule.description: Local Survey: at most one of L1 Channel, L2 Subchannel, or Key Account / Banner may be populated in Assignment Criteria - Customer Hierarchy.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Type__c, "Local Survey"), ( IF(NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(L1_Channel__c))), 1, 0) + IF(NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(L2_Subchannel__c))), 1, 0) + IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Key_Account__c)), 1, 0) ) > 1 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For Local Survey, populate at most one of L1 Channel, L2 Subchannel, or Key Account / Banner.
